authority.w2_position: Schedule follows the completed interaction owner in the approved W2 owner sequence.

sites.current_use: On idle, snapshotEvents().some(type === 'schedule/change') triggers the runtime after any Schedule history.
sites.proposed: Read schedule projection state and trigger when the owned suffix has seenIds; terminal IDs remain represented and inherited parent schedules do not wake a child.
sites.acceptance: Unrelated idle sessions remain unflushed; own active and terminal Schedule history still requests a drive; a fork with only inherited Schedule history does not request a no-op drive.

sites.current_use: Installer validates each already-live Session by replaying ownEvents().
sites.proposed: Require sessionProjections and register the shared strict Schedule projection unit before checking current state; stateOf must be defined or the companion fails at setup.
sites.acceptance: Valid baseline state installs; missing service/key fails loudly; non-empty late registration without a creation/restore baseline remains fail-closed.

sites.current_use: session/created validates a new Session by replaying ownEvents().
sites.proposed: Read the registry state after projection preparation has consumed the SessionCreationBaseline; require the Schedule key to exist.
sites.acceptance: Prepared valid seeds expose the exact fork-local state; malformed Schedule seeds fail before Session publication through projection transition validation.

sites.current_use: Before append, candidate validation allocates [...ownEvents(), event] and folds the whole stream.
sites.proposed: Read the committed ScheduleProjectionState and call the shared pure scheduleProjectionDefinition.apply(state, candidate); catch only ScheduleLogError and report fail without mutating the committed state.
sites.acceptance: Valid candidates append once and advance the registered unit once; invalid create/delete/dispatch candidates fail before append and leave state/watermark unchanged.

sites.current_use: Runtime rereads and folds ownEvents() during preflight and maintenance decisions.
sites.proposed: Read active and seen IDs from the live registry state at each existing decision point; retain flush barriers, idle claim, clock sampling, framing, dispatch ordering, and corruption fault behavior.
sites.acceptance: Timers remain exact for restored/fork-local creates and are updated by committed delete/dispatch; wall-clock, busy, failure, and disposal cases remain unchanged.

sites.current_use: After persistence preflight, tools fold ownEvents() for list, id allocation, and delete decisions.
sites.proposed: After the same preflight, read active and seen IDs through stateOf; preserve session-local create order and never-reused IDs.
sites.acceptance: List/create/delete results and uncertainty barriers remain stable; used IDs stay reserved after delete or dispatch, including resumed and forked Sessions.

baseline.current_registered_projection: packages/schedule/schedule/src/projection.ts already folds schedule/change from the immutable inheritedEventCount, validates active/seen IDs with the durable decoder, and has stateVersion 2.
baseline.current_consumption: Schedule plugin, timer runtime, tools, and invariant still read deprecated Session history methods at the six sites.
baseline.supported_composition: dsh-base and sdk-minimal both mount @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection; the documented Schedule overlay runs over the Web/base profile.
baseline.customization_owner_gap: Current session-reader-migration, session-context-reader-projections, and interaction-session-reader-invariants owners do not include Schedule paths. Add a dedicated schedule-session-projection-readers owner with solutionType upstream-package-change.

design.approach: Use the existing ScheduleProjectionState as the sole live current state for idle activation, synchronous event validation, timer decisions, and tools. Require SessionProjectionRegistry in Schedule composition. Keep schedule/change as durable authority and keep the projection state schema/version unchanged.
design.invariant_lifecycle: The schedule-invariant installer also registers the same scheduleProjectionDefinition on its child context before state checks; SessionProjectionRegistry ref-counts the same key/version, and disposing either contributing fiber removes only that contributor. This keeps the invariant companion usable without mounting the timer/tool plugin.
design.prefix_semantics: Use projection state built from the exact inheritedEventCount. Active records and seenIds represent only the owned suffix; no parent reminder enters a child runtime or tool result.
design.failure_semantics: Missing registry service is a plugin-composition error. Missing Schedule key or missing creation/restore baseline fails loudly. Invalid durable transitions remain ScheduleLogError and are mapped to existing corrupt_schedule_log behavior at tool/runtime read sites; rejected pre-commit candidates never mutate committed projection state.
design.external_falsifier: A valid Schedule state cannot be read at any of S053-S058 without snapshotEvents/ownEvents fallback, or a provider removal can leave a live consumer running without fail-closed disposal.

customization_owner.summary: Read Schedule durable state from its seed-aware Session projection for timers, tools, and synchronous event validation.

must_preserve: durable schedule/change payloads and replay results
fork-owned suffix semantics and non-reused IDs
persistence preflight/post-append barriers and existing errors
idle maintenance, timer, recurrence, ordering, cancellation, and disposal behavior

must_not_change: model-visible prompt/tool schemas or reminder framing
session/event producer/consumer count or ordering guarantees
checks_before_gate_pass: focused Schedule unit suite for projection, invariant, tools, runtime, and production JSONL restart
package typecheck and scoped Oxlint, including no deprecated reader suppression at S053-S058
exact customization-policy owner attribution for every implementation path
bilingual Schedule README, subsystem pair, and Agent Note pair with pairing sidecars
focused doc gates and no generated catalog changes unless an owning generator identifies an actual derived output
